# Informed arrow-interface boundary study

Issues #83/#46 and the existing nonnormative operations decision candidate have been read, along with the common checker, finite operation adapter, static formal transport and parser. This is informed specification/implementation work, not a blind model benchmark; no external model is invoked. Six original sources are preserved before checking: direct type-changing unitor, direct preparation, existing endomorphic control, a deliberate wrong endomorphic provider, and two desired general-arrow clients using the candidate comma spelling. The latter conflicts with the existing Meaning slot and is not adopted syntax. Observe actual failures without repairing or inventing outcomes. No generic QFT, new maximum-size case, acceptance fallback or numeric tolerance is involved. Native validity and producer consistency do not verify an external expected Meaning. Intended small exact matrix equations are separate from actual source checking and require the later source/artifact correspondence.
